description: This file defines the OpportunityFormBase class, which provides methods for handling Opportunity forms, including validation, UI rendering, duplication checks, and saving opportunities within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: OpportunityFormBase
classes.description: A class providing form handling, duplication checks, and save functionalities for Opportunities within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Checks for duplicate Opportunity records based on the submitted form data, primarily the 'name' field.

methods.name: buildTableForm
methods.description: Builds an HTML form displaying duplicate Opportunity records for user selection.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Returns HTML representing a form to create a new Opportunity.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Produces a comprehensive HTML form for Opportunity creation with detailed fields and account linking.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates a basic form snippet for Opportunity creation/editing.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission, validates, populates, and saves an Opportunity record, with optional redirection.
